name: MemberSpace – Sell community access, content, online courses, memberships and paid subscriptions
author: MemberSpace

sections.description:
Advanced membership and subscription software with more flexibility and more control, made simple and backed by real human support.

Build a membership community directly on your WordPress website and start accepting payments in minutes. With MemberSpace, you can lock access to any page and give members a dedicated portal where they can access everything they’ve paid for in one place.

Sell membership subscriptions to:

  • Private community (comments, posts and engagement)
  • Content library
  • Online courses
  • Newsletters
  • Videos
  • And more

A better way to run your membership

Gate content directly on your website

Easily lock access to any page on your WordPress site. Choose exactly what content is free and what requires a membership or subscription, without changing how your site is built.

An organized content hub for your members

MemberSpace also includes a built-in member portal that acts as a central hub for your community. It automatically appears on your website and gives your members a simple, organized way to access everything they’ve paid for.

  • Upload files, embed videos, write posts, and more
  • Organize content with folders and Spaces
  • Let members save bookmarks
  • Enable search across content and files

Together, page gating and the member portal give you full control over how your membership content is structured and experienced.

Why Choose MemberSpace?

1. No coding required

You don’t need technical skills to run a membership or subscription business. MemberSpace is designed to be simple so you can focus on your community, not your setup.

2. Your business, your platform

Most membership plugins lock you into WordPress. MemberSpace works across all major platforms, so you can move your site anytime without disrupting your members or their payments.

3. Real human support

Get fast, thoughtful help via live chat or email. Our team is known for being responsive and hands-on, with support available when you need it.

4. Everything happens on your website

Your members stay on your site for signup, login, payments, and accessing content. You keep full control over your brand and community experience.

5. Free migration

If you already run a membership or subscription elsewhere, we’ll help you move your members and payments over for free whenever possible.

Membership Features

Explore all features here: https://www.memberspace.com/features/.

Popular MemberSpace Features

  • Unlimited members
  • Tiered access across plans
  • Plan upgrades and downgrades
  • Abandoned signup recovery
  • Failed payment recovery
  • Cancellation alternatives
  • Instant payouts
  • Connect multiple websites

Flexible subscriptions and payments

  • Accept recurring subscriptions and one-time payments
  • Free trials with flexible lengths
  • Choose billing dates
  • Drip content over time
  • Coupon codes and promotions
  • Custom signup fields
  • Multiple currencies
  • Member approvals

Built to increase conversions and retention

  • Apple Pay and Google Pay for faster payments
  • Google signup and login for easier onboarding
  • Trial periods to reduce friction and improve conversion
  • Automated retention tools to reduce cancellations and save revenue

Designed for your members and community

  • Member portal with organized navigation
  • Upload and manage content in one place
  • Bookmarks and search for easy access
  • Sell the same content across multiple plans

Integrations

Stripe, Zapier, Rewardful, and more

Simple and customizable

  • Mobile responsive
  • Custom styling and wording
  • Export and manage members
  • Manually add members
  • Member emails
  • API access

Secure and reliable

  • Member analytics
  • Invoices and payment tracking
  • Encrypted security
  • Tax collection
  • Unlimited content protection
  • Multiple admins
sections.installation:
Getting started with MemberSpace is quick and simple. No coding required.

1. Create your account

Go to MemberSpace.com and create your free account.

2. Choose your platform

When prompted, select WordPress as your website platform.

3. Install the plugin

In your WordPress dashboard, install the MemberSpace plugin. It takes about 2 minutes.

4. Verify your install

Head back to MemberSpace and click “Verify Install” to confirm everything is connected.

5. Start building

You’re ready to go. Set up your member portal to protect any premium content, community forums, courses, or simply gate pages on your site. Offer whatever membership pricing you want.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code to use MemberSpace?

No. MemberSpace is built for non-technical users. You can install it, gate pages, and start selling memberships without writing any code.

Can I lock or protect any page on my WordPress site?

Yes. You can gate access to any page or section of your site and choose exactly which members or plans can access it.

What is the MemberSpace portal?

The MemberSpace portal is a built-in hub where your members can log in and access all of their content in one place. It automatically appears on your site and includes navigation, search, bookmarks, and more.

Can I accept payments and subscriptions?

Yes. You can accept recurring subscriptions, one-time payments, multi-payments, and free trials. MemberSpace integrates with Stripe to handle payments securely.

Can I sell different membership tiers or plans?

Yes. You can create multiple plans and control which content each plan can access. You can also offer upgrades, downgrades, and sell the same content across different tiers.

Can I use MemberSpace on platforms other than WordPress?

Yes. MemberSpace works with WordPress and other platforms like Webflow, Squarespace, Wix, and more. You’re never locked into one system.

Will my members stay on my website?

Yes. Signup, login, payments, and content access all happen directly on your website, so you keep full control over the experience.

Can I offer free trials or discounts?

Yes. You can create trial periods, coupon codes, and special offers to increase conversions and grow your membership.

What happens if a member cancels?

You can automatically show offers like discounts or extended trials to encourage members to stay and reduce churn.

Can I migrate from another membership platform?

Yes. We offer a free migration service and can help move your members and billing details whenever possible.

How long does it take to get set up?

Most people are up and running in minutes. Installing the plugin takes about 2 minutes, and you can start gating pages and accepting payments right away.

Is MemberSpace secure?

Yes. MemberSpace uses secure payment processing through Stripe and includes tools like content protection, member authentication, and encrypted data handling.

Is MemberSpace GDPR compliant?

Yes, MemberSpace is GDPR, CCPA, and SCA compliant. We use privacy and security rules to protect your personal information and keep your data safe.
